reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, testable mechanism—dynamic nano-precipitate formation during loading—that directly addresses progressive plastic deformation under continuous loading, with a clear intervention, measurable outcomes, and a falsification experiment, while extending prior findings on dynamic precipitation and recrystallization. Hypothesis A relies on a static microstructural feature (phase boundary coherency) that is less likely to govern creep resistance under sustained stress and does not go beyond textbook dislocation-barrier concepts.
